contexts.text: He saw all the plain of Jordan () = those goods and truths which are in the external man. The plain near the Jordan = the external man as to all his goods and truths. Explained.
Lot chose all the plain of Jordan () = that the external man is such.
Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain () = that the external man was in scientifics.
Stop not in all the plain () = that he should not tarry in any of (the doctrinals). The plain everything of what is doctrinal. Illustrated.
The plain of the earth () = the doctrinal things of the Church.
And all the plain () = all things which pertained to those truths.
When God destroyed the cities of the plain () = when they perished through the falsities of evil...
To descend into the plain () = the doctrinal things which are of the Rational.
The plain of the earth = the truth of the Church. A plain = the truth which is of what is doctrinal.
Inhabitant of the valley and of the rock of the plain () = the faith in which is no charity.
The plain of the Philistines () = the truth of faith; for plain = that which is doctrinal of faith.
Those not yet made Angels dwell in the plains between the mountains and the rocks.
The Spirits in the plains and valleys see each other...
Beyond the valley there was a plain...
The summit of the mountain was a plain.
When (these rocks) become a plain, it is well.
See Last Judgment. SE 5474. SE 5768.
The waters descending into the plain = influx into the natural man.
Under City, see this reference.
Those in the First Heaven dwell beneath in the plains and valleys.
The plain into which the waters descend = the ultimates of Heaven and the Church... AE 422:15. AE 513:7.
Valley, and plain = the ultimates of the Word...
A plain = good and truth in the natural man, because those in the Ultimate Heaven dwell in plains.
The plain of the desert () = where there is no intelligence.
